Old Rostov-on-Don airport (URRR in reference data). First allocation unknown; latest start is the 2016-03-19 airline observation. ROV passed to the separate new Platov airport on 2017-11-27 per Aeroflot citing an IATA notice; the time of day is unknown, so the whole day is uncertain. The 2017-12-07 passenger transfer and the 2018-03-01 legal closure are later, separate events. An unverified fan-site claim that the code was received on 2017-11-24 is treated as a notification date and recorded in docs/curated-admissions-pr8.md. The continuous interval between observations is a reviewed continuity inference, not an official allocation ledger or daily verification.

Platov inherits ROV on 2017-11-27 (day precision), ten days before its first passengers on 2017-12-07; opening is not the code boundary. The open end is not guaranteed future validity. The continuous interval between observations is a reviewed continuity inference, not an official allocation ledger or daily verification.

Temporary code for the old airport from 2017-11-27; in use on that day for SU flights. No RVI withdrawal record was found: passenger closure on 2017-12-07 and legal closure on 2018-03-01 do not withdraw a code, so the end has no latest bound and later RVI queries remain uncertain rather than inventing a withdrawal date. The continuous interval between observations is a reviewed continuity inference, not an official allocation ledger or daily verification.

Old Yantai Laishan airport. First allocation unknown; the 2014-11-10 report observes YNT as Laishan's current code. IATA had approved YNT for Penglai and planned a coordinate update from 2014-12-11, but no implementation record was found; the latest end is the 2015-05-28 00:00 civil closure of Laishan. Every date from 2014-11-10 to 2015-05-27 is therefore uncertain; neither the planned date nor the opening is asserted as the switch. The continuous interval between observations is a reviewed continuity inference, not an official allocation ledger or daily verification.

Separate Penglai site, 57 km by road from Laishan. Start bounded by the reported IATA approval (not before the 2014-11-10 observation of YNT at Laishan) and by the complete civil transfer at 2015-05-28 00:00; current AIP and snapshot corroborate continuity. ZSYT is not admitted: no changeover record exists between the 2013 Laishan chart and the 2025 Penglai AIP. The continuous interval between observations is a reviewed continuity inference, not an official allocation ledger or daily verification.

Old Phnom Penh (Pochentong) airport. First allocation unknown; latest start is a 2008-12-31 reference-dated observation. Airline operations under PNH continued through 2025-09-08 and moved to KTI at 00:01 local on 2025-09-09. No decision to withdraw or reuse PNH was found, so the end has no latest bound; later PNH queries stay uncertain. The continuous interval between observations is a reviewed continuity inference, not an official allocation ledger or daily verification.

First allocation unknown; latest start is the ICAO regional table dated 2014-04-25. Cambodia stated the aerodrome officially closes at 1700 UTC on 2025-09-08; aerodrome closure is not an indicator withdrawal, so the end has no latest bound. The continuous interval between observations is a reviewed continuity inference, not an official allocation ledger or daily verification.

Techo, a greenfield site separate from Pochentong and from Kratie. The IATA allocation date is unknown, so the start has no earliest bound. Schedules filed under KTI by 2025-07-22 were for travel from 2025-09-09 and show booking availability, not flights operated at Techo under KTI; they are not used as a flight-date boundary. Carriers moved operations at 00:01 local on 2025-09-09, so that whole local date stays uncertain and the latest start is 2025-09-10. KTI was previously associated with Kratie according to a Cambodian embassy notice, but no dated Kratie observation is admitted, so no Kratie assignment or reassignment boundary is asserted. The continuous interval between observations is a reviewed continuity inference, not an official allocation ledger or daily verification.

ICAO indicator issued before operation (date unknown); published AIP operation from 0000 UTC 2025-09-04. The AIP effective date is distinct from the 2025-09-09 airline move and from any IATA date. The continuous interval between observations is a reviewed continuity inference, not an official allocation ledger or daily verification.

Actual 2013-03-29 DKR flight at Yoff bounds unknown allocation. IATA announces withdrawal for 2017-12-07 and SAA describes old DKR during that transition. Later directories retain DKR, so implementation/reinstatement is unresolved: no latest-end bound and no certified DKR interval after 2017-12-06. DKR is never assigned to Diass here; city coding is separate. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between observations, not daily direct verification or an allocation ledger.

IATA explicitly confirms DSS already assigned to Blaise Diagne on 2017-11-21; latest start is the following whole local date. Original allocation remains unknown. This pre-opening bound is administrative allocation evidence, not a booking observation, flight schedule or claim of pre-opening passenger operations. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between observations, not daily direct verification or an allocation ledger.

Actual 2013-03-29 flight observes GOOY at Yoff; current AIP retains GOOY under military administration. No ICAO withdrawal is inferred from passenger relocation or the IATA DKR notice. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between observations, not daily direct verification or an allocation ledger.

GOBD charts effective 2017-12-07 0000 UTC establish the AIP state by that local date (Dakar UTC+0), not original indicator issue. October 12 publication does not bound allocation; the start remains open to the past. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between observations, not daily direct verification or an allocation ledger.

Actual operational AAP observation on 2019-08-20 bounds latest start to 2019-08-21. May 2018 opening, October 2018 inauguration and prospective schedules are not code bounds. Earlier AAP at Andrau Airpark is outside admitted coverage; earlier dates remain uncertain. SRI withdrawal and WALS reuse are not certified. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between observations, not daily direct verification or an allocation ledger.

Observed on 2016-08-08 at the old Chaklala site; AIP AD 2 OPRN-1 dated 2021-03-25 still identifies the same runway after civil operations moved to OPIS. Coverage ends conservatively at that last observation (exclusive), not an asserted withdrawal. The fixed directory has OPRN only in gps_code, with blank icao_code; it does not extend ICAO coverage. No OPRN transfer to the new airport or new entity for military use. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between dated observations, not daily direct verification, a first-allocation date, or proof that flights operated on every resolved date.

Unknown original allocation; administrative AIP designation at the new site is documented effective 2017-06-22 0001 UTC (0501 local), hence the next whole-local-date latest-start bound. Commissioning was expressly deferred to a NOTAM; this does not establish flights in 2017 or use the 2018 opening as an ICAO transfer. OPRN belongs to the separate old site. Continued OPIS is corroborated by official 2026 AIP and the unchanged fixed evidence horizon. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between dated observations, not daily direct verification, a first-allocation date, or proof that flights operated on every resolved date.

Actual 2011-10-15 France-local flight record identifies departure LTBA at Ataturk. No departure time is given; a conservative additional local-day rollover yields latest start 2011-10-17. The 2026 AD 2 entry retains LTBA at Ataturk after the IATA IST/ISL exchange. Neither that passenger move nor changes in civil operations transfer LTBA to the new site. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between dated observations, not daily direct verification, a first-allocation date, or proof that flights operated on every resolved date.

Unknown original allocation; SUP 04/18 documents administrative LTFM designation effective 2018-10-11, with no effective instant proved, so the conservative latest start is October 12. Its procedures and airport commissioning remained conditional on service/NOTAM; resolution before service identifies the designated site, not an operated flight. Actual LTFM departure is separately observed in the 2019-12-31 occurrence record. No ICAO transfer from LTBA or backdating from the IATA IST change is asserted. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between dated observations, not daily direct verification, a first-allocation date, or proof that flights operated on every resolved date.

Actual 2016-07-08 flight identifies EDDB at Schonefeld. The existing Fluko evidence establishes Brandenburg as an extension of the same airside infrastructure; operator manual retains EDDB at Brandenburg. One continuous assignment to the existing physical ID across the 2020 SXF/BER change, T5 incorporation and T1 opening. No duplicate airport entity or invented ICAO transfer date. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between dated observations, not daily direct verification, a first-allocation date, or proof that flights operated on every resolved date.

ANAC reconstructs actual 2016-04-29 UACC arrival/departure at Astana. Its log-table time standard is absent: allowing a local-day rollover at historical UTC+6 gives conservative latest start 2016-05-01. BEA confirms a local-dated 2018 landing; official 2026 AIP retains UACC on the same runway/site after TSE/NQZ. Renaming the city or airport and changing IATA code do not create another physical identity or a UACC transfer. The whole interval is a reviewed continuity inference between dated observations, not daily direct verification, a first-allocation date, or proof that flights operated on every resolved date.
